sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:64

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:64:1
items.html:
In the upper AVI there is MA and BON, except that they are two Partzufim attached together always face to face, like Atik: The matter of the division of MA and BON among the Partzufim of Atzilut has already been brought above (page 654, the passage beginning “And it needs”, see there); and from there you will understand that these AVI that the ARI brings here are together with the YESHSUT that clothe AA from the Chazeh and below, to the Tabur; and it is found that Aba is the first and third pairs, whose MA is Keter, Hochma and the ZA of Bina, and whose BON is the seven lower ones of Hochma. And these are called Aba, and they clothe AA on the right side, from the throat to the Tabur; and about them the ARI says that the MA and BON in him are attached together always face to face, like Atik. That is, just as the MA and BON in Atik are a single Partzuf, so these MA and BON in Aba are only a single Partzuf, which clothes the right of AA, to the Tabur.
And likewise the MA and BON in Ima, who includes also Tevuna: her MA is Ima and the Nukva, and her BON is the six lower ones — Gevura, Tifferet and NHYM — which clothe AA on the left side, from the throat to the Tabur. And about them the ARI says that the MA and BON in Ima are attached very tightly face to face, like Atik, namely, that they became a single body, like Atik. Indeed, the matter of the upper AVI, which are regarded as two Partzufim, separate from one another, attached in one wall face to face, refers to the two bodies above: the MA and BON that are joined into one body and clothe the right side of AA, called together Aba, are attached face to face in one wall with the MA and BON that are joined into one body and clothe the left side of AA, called Ima. And understand this well.
